charcoal-ink.$description: Charcoal Ink — Primary text, dark photographic overlays, dark page bands, logo marks, and iconography

workshop-ivory.$description: Workshop Ivory — Page canvas, light hero fields, and broad editorial section backgrounds

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Warm light text over dark media, light pill actions, and high-contrast light surfaces

studio-white.$description: Studio White — Filled pill actions, product-interface surfaces, and compact elevated media controls

soft-paper.$description: Soft Paper — Large display text on dark imagery and the palest alternate surface

drafting-line.$description: Drafting Line — Hairline borders, card fills, image frames, and dividers

quiet-graphite.$description: Quiet Graphite — Secondary body copy and subdued supporting descriptions

faded-graphite.$description: Faded Graphite — Tertiary metadata, low-emphasis icons, and supporting labels

signal-coral.$description: Signal Coral — Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases

geist.$description: Primary editorial and interface family. Use 400 at 120px for display headlines; its -8px tracking and 0.93 line-height make the message read as a compressed poster rather than a conventional marketing headline. Use 500 for section titles, body hierarchy, and interface controls.

fragment-mono.$description: Technical microtype for all-caps navigation, small labels, status text, and compact metadata. At 10px with +0.3px tracking, it gives the interface its workshop-inventory character against the expressive Geist display type.
